sections.Profile:
The "Shoot the Moon" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on November 24, 1951, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Rockets
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Concept: Harry Williams
- Design: Harry Williams
sections.Editions: - Shoot the Moon: released 1951-11-01, model number 59
